review_method: All six final PNGs were opened with view_image and visually inspected in this chat. This file records that inspection; it is not an automated aesthetic test.
observations: Overview and top-down retain the 100m forest diorama, separate pond and beach, paths, trees and rock grouping.
Lake close-up shows textured props, bridge and shoreline with no editor UI or selection overlays. Generated texture modulation is deliberately subtle within the original palette.

Beach and both water time samples show a pale shoreline foam band, moving crest stripes and bright caustic-like patterns. Caustics remain below the lowest theoretical wave surface after the depth fix.
The two fixed-camera water images visibly change foam/crest positions and caustic pattern shapes while static shore props remain aligned.
limitations: The coast remains visibly polygonal, consistent with the original stylized geometry.
Fine distant crest/caustic lines show some aliasing at the grazing view.
These are shader-based artistic water effects, not a physical fluid or refracted-light solver.
